features.name: Simple / Pro modes
features.description: Simple creation screen; Pro exposes LoRA, keyframe, identity, motion, audio, experimental and budget tools.
features.limits: Presentation changes; Pro is not a separate model or a quality guarantee.

features.name: Image-to-video
features.description: Starting image + positive/negative prompts produce motion and native audio.
features.limits: **Real MP4 generation proved.** Normal UI and approved composed-frame route use single-image I2V.

features.name: Text-only generation
features.description: Official LTX supports broader text/video/audio tasks.
features.limits: This app's ordinary Generate callback **requires a starting image**. J.O.A.T. can obtain a missing image through Reference Lab; do not advertise a direct text-only mode in this UI.

features.name: Scene prompts and camera tags
features.description: Describe action, camera, setting and sound; append camera/motion wording through tags.
features.limits: Camera tags guide a generative model, not a deterministic 3-D camera rig. Controlled jobs compile approved camera/performance packets.

features.name: Local prompt enhancement
features.description: Local image-aware sulphur enhancer expands a concept into a detailed prompt.
features.limits: Separate GPU-decorated enhancement request; extra model/runtime cost. Optional, not required for our already-approved prompts.

features.name: Remote prompt assistance
features.description: Selected writing Space proposes a richer prompt plus suggested LoRAs/strengths.
features.limits: Sends idea/image to an external writing Space and can consume separate GPU allowance. Preserve the approved script instead of repeatedly rewriting it.

features.name: AI Scene Planner
features.description: Proposes clip count, separate action prompts and per-clip durations, with editable review sheet.
features.limits: Implemented; no video until generation starts. Default Qwen writer uses batches of up to two clips; other configured writers up to six. Long plans require multiple writer calls. Not our approved Director or QC system.

features.name: Scene Builder
features.description: Runs **1–64 clips**, one generation request each, using the previous clip's last frame; joins completed results with audio.
features.limits: Implemented; whole-scene production quality not qualified for our film. A 64-clip limit is not a promise that quota, continuity or memory can complete 64 clips.

features.name: Stop / resume / progress
features.description: Shows current clip and completed count; retains queue on stop/error; resumes at a chosen unfinished clip.
features.limits: Native state/files must still exist. Browser/session recovery is weaker than our durable private production checkpoints. Progress is completed clips, not measured denoising percentage.

features.name: Extend existing video
features.description: Upload a clip or continue the current result from its actual last frame, then stitch original + extension.
features.limits: Implemented; creates new footage using GPU. It is continuation from an end frame, not arbitrary temporal editing of every uploaded frame. Resets incompatible guides for a fresh uploaded continuation.

features.name: Identity Lock
features.description: Optional portrait; guarded face correction on CPU; gentle face attention anchor; manual bbox/automatic targeting controls.
features.limits: Helps likeness, not a guarantee. Occlusion, unsuitable angle or uncertain alignment can skip correction. One prominent face; no qualified multi-person identity tracking. Our approved composed-frame route does **not** send an extra portrait; it relies on approved scene-frame provenance and subsequent QC.

features.name: Multi-reference / MSR
features.description: Backend retains subject/background slots, guide-frame count and guide/LoRA strength controls; separate original path.
features.limits: Normal input selector and extra reference uploads are **hidden**, fixed to I2V in the UI. Earlier MSR work had duration/graph problems; do not treat the hidden path as newly qualified.

features.name: End-frame guidance
features.description: Supply a desired last image with strength.
features.limits: Implemented; promising next qualification for a shot needing a clear final pose. Does not guarantee the exact physical action.

features.name: Intermediate keyframes
features.description: Up to **five** extra images at percentage positions; sorted into temporal order, alongside starting/ending images.
features.limits: Implemented; additional approved stills may be needed. Keyframe injection is skipped in MSR. Exact action timing/identity between keys still require QC.

features.name: Motion Control
features.description: Driving video converted to **pose**, **depth** or **canny edges**, with guide and LoRA strengths and control preview.
features.limits: Implemented, not live-qualified for our actors. Potentially useful for salon gestures or product/camera movement. This path rejects a simultaneous separate identity portrait. Track preparation may use CPU/models; generating the guided video still uses GPU.

features.name: LoRA Studio
features.description: Custom Hugging Face/file/CivitAI links and uploads; separate video/audio strengths; pre-download/check; trigger words.
features.limits: Implemented, optional. First 13 custom lines have sliders; more can specify strengths in text. The legacy slider parameter names do not mean those named adapters are bundled/active. Our controlled route neutralizes unrelated adapters.

features.name: LoRA discovery / Refresh
features.description: Relevant rotating suggestions, selected entries retained, trigger ownership tracking, up to two guided selections; shared catalogue.
features.limits: Refresh itself makes no AI generation request, though it performs catalogue/network checks. Suggested or pinned entries are not automatically loaded or quality-approved. Manual Pro stacking can exceed the guided two-choice limit.

features.name: Art-style flexibility
features.description: Starting image, wording and compatible LoRAs can steer stylized or realistic output.
features.limits: No qualified one-click library of every animation style. Lock style per project and compare actual outputs; a LoRA cannot guarantee identity. The current 10Eros fine-tune is not automatically optimal for every clean commercial style.

features.name: Native audio
features.description: Joint audio-video generation: prompt can ask for room tone, effects, music or spoken lines.
features.limits: **Audio-bearing MP4s proved.** Exact spoken wording, stable character voices, singing and precise lip sync are not qualified capabilities. Keep our existing CPU narration for controlled copy.

features.name: Audio Studio
features.description: Reference audio guidance, normalization, optional voice/stem separation, per-adapter audio strengths.
features.limits: Implemented voice-transfer guidance, not a certified voice-cloning/lip-sync product. Source disables audio reference in the MSR/internal scene-chain paths.

features.name: Soundtrack Mixer
features.description: Upload audio, trim/loop or silence-pad to video length, fade, replace or mix with generated audio; adjust levels.
features.limits: Runs on **CPU**. This is supplied-audio fitting, not a dedicated music-composition or exact-lyrics system. This audit did not call the native mixer; J.O.A.T. post already has independently tested CPU audio processing.

features.name: Final Cut / queue joining
features.description: Add existing clips, clear queue, join/retry, keep audio, normalize media and provide downloadable video.
features.limits: **CPU** joining, not a full multitrack NLE. Our approved timeline/post/delivery services remain responsible for complete commercial assembly and final QC. Native join handler was inspected, not exercised here.

features.name: Resolution / aspect
features.description: Automatic target megapixels; custom width/height; 32/64 grid controls.
features.limits: UI allows 0.1–4 MP target and 512–1536 custom limits. Our controlled aspect mappings include landscape, vertical, square, 4:3 and 21:9; current film uses 1024×576. These controls are not proof of reliable 4K output.

features.name: Speed / refinement
features.description: **Economy, Fast, Economy+, Balanced, Quality**; sampling/refinement settings.
features.limits: Actual default is **Economy+ (0.65 MP, two refine steps)**. README's claim that Economy is the default is stale. Approved composed-I2V instead fixes resolution and skips refinement. Do not silently swap that setting from a UI preset.

features.name: Spatial upscaling
features.description: An LTX spatial-upscaler/refinement stage exists in the loaded workflow.
features.limits: It is part of the generative pipeline, not a separately qualified general-purpose restoration/export-resolution service. Our skip-refine path bypasses refinement. Official temporal upscalers/newer pipelines should not be advertised as active controls here.

features.name: Seeds / repeatability
features.description: Fixed or randomized seed, positive/negative prompts and tunable anchors/cache/sigma schedules.
features.limits: Useful for controlled comparisons; same seed is not a universal identity or byte-identical-output guarantee.

features.name: JSON and named profiles
features.description: Save settings, prompts, scene plans/timings, writer choice and adapter selections; import/export compatible older schemas.
features.limits: Uploaded image/audio/video bytes are not embedded. The UI label saying prompts are omitted conflicts with source: positive/negative prompts and scene prompts **are included**. Named profiles are shared and use `/data` if writable, otherwise temp storage; durability is not established simply by saving a name.

features.name: Experimental controls
features.description: Prompt relay/timed segments, K/V conditioning and internal scene chaining.
features.limits: Explicitly experimental; not the same as ordinary Scene Builder. Various paths suppress incompatible combinations. Keep these off in the approved film lane until a concrete need is qualified.

features.name: Diagnostics / budget
features.description: Download process/memory events; CPU-only I2V/MSR graph/runtime checks; reservation estimates and optional overrides.
features.limits: No-GPU readiness checks do not prove GPU admission or video quality. Reservation is a ceiling/request, not usage, price or entitlement. Controlled jobs currently use a fixed 600-second ceiling.

features.name: Export
features.description: Produces downloadable MP4, aims for 24fps H.264/yuv420p/AAC and avoids unnecessary re-encode when compatible.
features.limits: Export can fall back to original result after an encoding error. Independent full decode/hash/codec/duration/audio checks remain essential before approval.

conditions: independent full media and creative QC

project_templates.art_style: Realism requires its own approved reference set and visual qualification
